nodes.statement: Represent one selected bodily/action self-related audit profile as S=(O,G,H,C), with ownership, agency, retentive familiarity and current practical coupling kept typed and distinct.
nodes.scope: Finite candidate audit vocabulary; not an exhaustive ontology or actual-token admission.
nodes.quantifier: For every application that elects to use this four-coordinate audit profile.

nodes.statement: An admissible Boolean scalarization is coordinatewise monotone and maps the all-zero and all-one profiles to zero and one respectively.
nodes.scope: Boolean functions on the declared finite profile only.
nodes.quantifier: For every scalarization in the declared family.

nodes.statement: The declared four-coordinate premises admit 166 scalarizations and do not identify one global familiar-mineness bit.
nodes.scope: The declared binary monotone profile model.
nodes.quantifier: There exist 166 endpoint-fixed nonconstant monotone Boolean functions; more than one remains under coordinate symmetry.

nodes.statement: Ownership-without-agency and agency-without-ownership are incomparable and receive every possible pair of aggregate labels across admissible two-coordinate scalarizations.
nodes.scope: The ownership/agency subprofile in the declared finite model.
nodes.quantifier: Across all four admissible two-coordinate scalarizations.

nodes.statement: Complement orientation requires a preselected typed target or an explicitly stipulated aggregate; it cannot select ownership, agency, familiarity, coupling or their aggregation.
nodes.scope: UCT self-related endpoint and transport arguments.
nodes.quantifier: For every application of a complement-orientation theorem.

nodes.statement: O, G and H are experience-related targets while C is an actual-organization relation; evidence about C neither defines a feeling nor proves same-episode use.
nodes.scope: Every physical application of the typed profile.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed measurement or bridge between C and O, G or H.

nodes.statement: Any aggregate must supply an independently justified purpose, domain and aggregation convention with counterexamples.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed aggregate of two or more typed coordinates.

nodes.statement: Target retentive familiarity H directly, use O and G as dissociation controls and C as an organizational candidate bridge, while preserving signed evidence, same-instance provenance, transport and non-gate constraints.
nodes.scope: Future bodily/action-related UCT research; not a basal gate or assistant verdict.
nodes.quantifier: For every future attempt to explain familiar mineness positively.

rules.statement: Enumerate every Boolean truth table and retain exactly the endpoint-fixed coordinatewise monotone functions.
rules.binding: One fixed coordinate order, one profile domain and one scalarization family are used throughout.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Additional substantive aggregation axioms may select a function but are not consequences of these premises.

rules.statement: Evaluate all admissible scalarizations on the two incomparable ownership/agency profiles.
rules.binding: Ownership and agency retain their types while the aggregate function alone varies.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A chosen purpose-specific aggregator fixes labels by convention rather than identification.

rules.statement: Infer only the interface requirement that target selection precedes complement orientation.
rules.binding: One proposed familiar-mineness target is compared against the same typed profile and aggregate family.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A predeclared retentive-familiarity coordinate remains eligible for separate orientation.

rules.statement: Type experiential target coordinates separately from actual practical-coupling relations and their tests.
rules.binding: Bearer, episode, experiential coordinate, route, carrier and consumer must remain one declared application and must not be replaced by test labels.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If actual use is not established, retain C as an evidential candidate only.

rules.statement: Continue with coordinate-specific endpoint and transport tests, keeping any aggregation explicit and defeasible.
rules.binding: One target H, one bearer/episode, separately measured O and G, and one actually evidenced C relation are required per application.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If H cannot be independently targeted, retain the bridge as open rather than substituting an aggregate score.

context_links.statement: R198 conditionally structures self-related research but neither proves nor replaces C1.
No profile coordinate or aggregate is required for basal experience.
Familiar mineness is narrowed to a named retentive-familiarity target rather than a global scalar.
Profile or test success does not establish lineage or current consumer use.
Transport must preserve coordinate type and cannot silently replace H with O, G, C or an aggregate.
